verdict.rationale: Gumloop offers two flavors of API key chosen at generation time, and team (workspace) keys are scoped to a single team. That gives coarse, team-level limiting of what a credential can reach. However, the docs say both auth methods grant the same permissions and work on every endpoint, so there is no evidence of fine-grained, least-privilege scopes. Missing for 10: per-agent credentials, endpoint/action-level or read-only scopes, documented permission model for keys, and independent corroboration.
